title: 在岸利率低：熊猫债融资需求强，政策会否加码？
speaker: Erica Tay

segments.en: Um, so I think we can expect two things that might be discussed at this Beijing forum
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为我们可以预期北京论坛可能讨论两件事

segments.en: Number one might be more initiatives to increase the use of a renminbi internationally

segments.zh: 我们知道多年来一直在努力增加人民币的使用

segments.en: Around the world. But so far we are seeing some traction because
segments.zh: 在全球范围内。但到目前为止我们看到一些进展，因为

segments.en: There has been very strong fun raising demand using the renminbi which is quite unusual and it speaks to the current
segments.zh: 使用人民币的融资需求非常强劲，这相当不寻常，说明当前的

segments.en: Rates environment now, so um, you know rates onshore are at a globally low level compared to
segments.zh: 利率环境，嗯，你知道在岸利率处于全球低位，相比

segments.zh: 其他发达市场，所以很多公司抓住这个机会

segments.en: So a secondly we can also expect more policy initiatives
segments.zh: 其次，我们也可以预期更多政策举措

segments.en: To grow the private equity sector for tech and innovation companies
segments.zh: 来发展科技和创新公司的私募股权部门

segments.zh: 所以我们可能会听到北京证券交易所的消息。它处于最前沿
